title: Good fan
text: Good fan. A really cute fan with 3 speeds. Works really good. Sturdy, blows out good air, light weight, fun colors. And it's rechargeable!

product_metadata.title: O2COOL Multi-Pack Neck Personal Travel USB Battery Powered Deluxe Cooling Fan, Single Pack (Gray)
features: PERSONAL COOLING FAN: When the heat hits, our powerful 3 speed fan keeps you cool! Vertical air vent ensures you're getting a cool breeze so you stay cool, dry, and comfortable.
TRAVEL FAN: Put on the fan whenever you step out in the sun hands free! It's a must-have for the beach, pool, camp, hiking, travel, wedding, picnic, park, concert or sporting event!
PORTABLE NECK FAN: This hands-free around the neck adjustable lanyard mini travel fan is perfect for any activities, on-the-go or relaxing around at home.
SLIM PROFILE: Compact design allows you to easily carry, place on table with top stand or wear on your hip. Lightweight small fan makes it great for anyone - kids, teens, men & women.
USB BATTERY OPERATED: Our premium quite face fans are designed to be the highest quality for your satisfaction. Run on Low up to 11.5 hours, Medium up to 8 hours and High up to 5.5 hours.
